grading.grading_notes: The submission fails to infer implicit currencies (EUR, GBP) and assumes all amounts are already in USD. It also fails to parse European number formats (e.g., 9.961,68), resulting in blank values for those rows. The tax rates file is completely ignored rather than resolving the missing values. Operating expenses are not mapped into a consistent taxonomy. Consequently, all numerical totals are incorrect. The deliverables are correctly named and formatted, earning points for compliance.
